cpi.source: World Bank Global Economic Monitor (GEM, source id 15), api.worldbank.org
cpi.transformation: none (raw index, source: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics via World Bank Global Economic Monitor)

exchange_rate.source: World Bank Global Economic Monitor (GEM, source id 15), api.worldbank.org
exchange_rate.transformation: none (source: IMF International Financial Statistics via World Bank Global Economic Monitor)

exchange_rate_neer.source: World Bank Global Economic Monitor (GEM, source id 15), api.worldbank.org
exchange_rate_neer.notes: Trade-weighted, so more informative than the bilateral PKR/US$ rate about Pakistan's overall external competitiveness.

exchange_rate_reer.description: Real Effective Exchange Rate (NEER adjusted for relative inflation)
exchange_rate_reer.source: World Bank Global Economic Monitor (GEM, source id 15), api.worldbank.org
exchange_rate_reer.notes: Adjusts NEER for inflation differentials with trading partners -- the standard measure of real external competitiveness.

industrial_activity.description: Industrial Production, constant US$ -- proxy for real economic activity
industrial_activity.source: World Bank Global Economic Monitor (GEM, source id 15), api.worldbank.org

reserves.source: World Bank Global Economic Monitor (GEM, source id 15), api.worldbank.org

broad_money_m2.source: World Bank World Development Indicators (WDI), api.worldbank.org
broad_money_m2.notes: No free monthly source found; World Bank GEM does not carry broad money. Annual WDI series used instead -- see DATA.md.

policy_rate_proxy.description: Lending interest rate -- PROXY for SBP's policy (target) rate, which the World Bank does not publish. Replace with the actual SBP policy-rate series once collected during MPhil fieldwork (see DATA.md).
policy_rate_proxy.source: World Bank World Development Indicators (WDI), api.worldbank.org
policy_rate_proxy.notes: TEMPORARY PROXY -- not the SBP policy rate. See DATA.md.

cpi_inflation_yoy.transformation: 100 * (log(value_t) - log(value_t-12)), computed after sorting by date
